title: One diagonal contribution to multiplication
statement: Let $x$ be a finite bit string and let $v$ be a vector of thirteen natural-number registers, each at most $4(|x|+1)$. In the fixed multiplication register program, a configuration in the diagonal-processing state with registers $v$ and no answer can reach a configuration in the next-$b$ state with registers identical except that register 11 is increased by $v_{11}+[v_{10}=v_7]x_{v_0}x_{v_9}$, and still with no answer.
hypotheses_covered: $v$ is a vector of thirteen natural-number registers
